name: cdtask
description: A task-definition Skill for AI Coding Agents. Use when CDF provides an approved managed plan, standalone CDP hands off approved work for persistence, or a stable requirement must be split into tasks. Converts approved plans into scoped, dependency-aware, verifiable task definitions and executor handoff information. It may persist task documents, but it does not execute, schedule, or manage a lifecycle.
author: webszy

install.codex: npx skills add https://github.com/webszy/my-skills --skill cdtask -a codex -g -y
install.claudeCode: npx skills add https://github.com/webszy/my-skills --skill cdtask -a claude-code -g -y
install.both: npx skills add https://github.com/webszy/my-skills --skill cdtask -a codex -a claude-code -g -y
